title: What If a Magnitude 7.3 Quake Hit Tokyo?

scenes.text: What if a magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck right under Tokyo? The city has already done the math.
Its own 2022 estimate: more than 6,000 deaths and about 93,000 injuries.
Around 80,000 buildings would collapse, and more than 194,000 would be damaged.
Fires would be deadly in themselves. About 2,500 of those deaths would come from flames, not shaking.
Roughly 4.5 million people would be left without shelter.
The 2012 forecast was over 9,000 deaths. The new forecast is about a third lower, and officials want to halve it.
